title: docs(ui-merge): merge the 46 objectui field, Console-behaviour and schema pages into the objectstack docs (K2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoG9P9JXRHobEih4L9R3ef1b)_

Fixes #27141

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 objectui 文档里 46 页(27 个字段页、14 个 Console/元数据行为页、5 个 schema 页)中 objectstack 文档缺的内容并入现有页面;新增 Console 和 Studio 两页,其余并入 field-types、apps、pages、actions、dashboards、forms、create-vs-edit-form、print-pages、react-pages、ai/skills。
- 为什么改:objectui.org 将并入 objectstack 文档站(方案 B),作者以后只看 objectstack.ai/docs,字段和页面行为不能一半留在要下线的站点上。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,不动代码和 `ui/content/docs`;与 spec 冲突的说法(如 `menu`、`grid` 字段类型、`${}` 写的 visibleWhen、旧 report/action 组件形状)一律未搬。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:下方 46 行映射表(K4 据此做跳转),以及新页 `content/docs/ui/console.mdx`、`content/docs/ui/studio.mdx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs build` 绿;打开 /docs/ui/console、/docs/ui/studio、/docs/data-modeling/field-types 看渲染。
- 需要你做的:无需决策;CI 绿后按常规审阅合并。

## What changes

Card K2 of the objectui.org docs fold. The 46 pages the card names are merged into the existing objectstack pages: only what the target lacked (widget and display behaviour, Console interaction, worked examples) was carried, rewritten as plain code blocks; what the target already says was dropped; where the two disagreed the target's wording was kept; and every carried claim was read against `packages/spec`, so an objectui claim that contradicts the spec was dropped or corrected, not merged.

- `data-modeling/field-types.mdx` keeps one page with per-type **In the Console** paragraphs and a new **How the Console renders a field** section, so its existing anchors survive.
- Two new pages: `ui/console.mdx` (how the Console renders metadata, per-user state, predicate failures) and `ui/studio.mdx` (access and package scope, drafts, object design, the Flow Designer, metadata diagnostics). Both are listed in `ui/meta.json` and the module index.
- `ui/print-pages.mdx` and `ui/react-pages.mdx` are now the single page for their topic.
- Nothing under `ui/content/docs/`, `ui/apps/site` or `content/docs/sdk/` is touched; K4 retires the old pages and adds redirects from the table below.

### Old path → target (46 rows)

| Old page (`ui/content/docs/…`) | Target (`content/docs/…`) | Carried |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fields/auto-number` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#autonumber` | The Console assigns the number on insert (the create form shows it empty) and the format-token table |
| `fields/boolean` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#boolean` | Switch in forms; read-only and grid display reads Yes / No |
| `fields/currency` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#currency` | Input with the currency symbol; read-only and grid display |
| `fields/date` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#date`, `#deadlines-duelike-and-settledwhen` | A date is a calendar day shown the same in every timezone; the picker; the `dueLike` / `settledWhen` deadline rendering |
| `fields/datetime` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#datetime` | A datetime is an instant rendered in the viewer's timezone; the combined picker |
| `fields/email` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#email` | Email input; `mailto:` link when read-only and in grids |
| `fields/file` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#media-types`, `#file` | Value is the bare `sys_file` id(s); upload refusal; `maxSize` checked before upload; restricted files (`metadataRefused`) draw a lock; legacy inline objects still render; list display |
| `fields/formula` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#formula` | Read-only, drawn by `returnType` |
| `fields/grid` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#master_detail` | `grid` is not a spec `FieldType`, so the page's widget content went to the `master_detail` inline grid (`InlineGridColumnSchema` columns, derived columns, ordering). Dropped: `grid` as a field type |
| `fields/image` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#image` | Thumbnail grid in forms, three thumbnails plus a count in grids, `accept` defaults to `image/*` |
| `fields/location` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#location` | Latitude-then-longitude input and its display |
| `fields/lookup` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#lookup` | Typeahead and Record Picker, `lookupColumns` (string widths), `lookupPageSize`, `displayField` / `descriptionField`, quick create (`allowCreate`), dependent lookups. Dropped: `reference_field`, `avatar_field`, picker `subtitle` (not spec keys) |
| `fields/number` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#number`, `#what-a-number-input-silently-rewrites` | Stepper (`step`), the `useGrouping` table, what a native number input announces and silently rewrites |
| `fields/object` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#json` | `json`, `composite` and `record` share a JSON text editor; what it accepts and refuses |
| `fields/password` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#password` | Masked input with show/hide; stored value masked when read-only |
| `fields/percent` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#percent` | `scale` as displayed decimals and input step; the fraction-vs-whole storage rule |
| `fields/phone` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#phone` | `tel` input and link. Dropped: the input mask (the widget reads no `format` mask) |
| `fields/rich-text` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#richtext` | One shared editor for `markdown` / `html` / `richtext`, and what `type` changes |
| `fields/select` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#select` | Dropdown and colour badges, empty-label fallback, cascading options (`visibleWhen` / `dependsOn`), server enforcement of the option set |
| `fields/summary` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#summary` | Read-only roll-up drawn by one rule in form and grid |
| `fields/text` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#text` | Single-line input; `placeholder` |
| `fields/textarea` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#textarea` | `rows` as the editor height |
| `fields/time` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#time` | 24-hour `HH:mm` input |
| `fields/url` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#url` | URL input; only `http(s)` values become links |
| `fields/user` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#user` | Search-first people picker delegating to the lookup picker |
| `fields/vector` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#vector` | Read-only; the form previews the first values and the dimension count |
| `fields/widget-props` | `data-modeling/field-types.mdx#how-the-console-renders-a-field` | Metadata keys vs runtime widget props, `widget`, the shared empty-value affordance. Not carried: the `FieldWidgetComponentProps` API detail beyond one sentence (SDK) |
| `guide/console` | `ui/console.mdx` (new), `ui/studio.mdx` (new) | Configuration inputs, navigating, record overlay modes and the drawer stack, the Approvals tab, refused dashboards and list views; Studio access, package scope, read-only packages, flows in no package, Create app, copilot drafts, object design panels and why an action can be missing. Not carried: dev quick start and source layout (repo-internal), Setup Positions, the app creation wizard |
| `guide/metadata-diagnostics` | `ui/studio.mdx#metadata-diagnostics`, `ui/console.mdx#when-a-predicate-cannot-be-evaluated` | The `_diagnostics` envelope, the sweep endpoint and its response (`stats` includes `locked`), the four Studio surfaces, CEL lint on drafts, the runtime fail-open / fail-closed table, submit refusal, blank rules. Corrected: the `/api/v1/meta/items/…` paths (no such route) and `os check` (the command is `os validate`). Not carried: `MetadataClient` / `useGlobalDiagnostics` (SDK) |
| `guide/flow-designer` | `ui/studio.mdx#the-flow-designer` | Canvas gestures, the palette (search, categories, recents, server merge), the inspector (required markers, `configSchema` forms, approver values, decision branches, assignments), the four panels |
| `guide/notifications` | `ui/console.mdx#notifications` | The bell reads the server inbox through one shared feed. Not carried: the React notification API (SDK; `NotificationSchema` is not in the spec) |
| `guide/slotted-pages` | `ui/pages.mdx#record-pages` | The synthesized default (tab strip, `relatedList: 'primary'`, Attachments, width-based layout), the slot table, the discussion panel and `enable.feeds`, related-list gating, paging and action ids, header action placement and the refresh button. Corrected: `details` + `tabs` are refused together (the spec), not "tabs wins". Dropped: `relatedLayout` (not a spec key) and the `@object-ui/plugin-detail` sub-builders (SDK) |
| `guide/record-edit-modes` | `ui/create-vs-edit-form.mdx#modal-or-page-editmode` | `editMode` (`modal` / `page`), the page routes, `navigate_create` / `navigate_edit` buttons with `properties.params` templates |
| `guide/designing-app-navigation` | `ui/apps.mdx#designing-the-navigation` | Landing-URL table for plain / `viewName` / `filters` / page entries, the rule of least power, label fallback. Dropped: "`menu` is deprecated legacy" (the spec refuses `menu`) |
| `guide/dashboard-filters` | `ui/dashboards.mdx#filter-controls-and-options`, `#in-the-console` | Control-type → condition table, static options and the refused string shorthand, `optionsFrom`, the `object` translation key, symbolic presets, `page.dateRange` shape, nested variable scopes, the Studio bindings inspector, Refresh All. Not carried: the tutorial steps the target already covers |
| `guide/public-forms` | `ui/forms.mdx#6-internal-forms-_consoleformsname` | `/apps/:appName/forms/:name`, heading resolution, Cancel. Not carried: `EmbeddableForm` (SDK component, its own security options) |
| `guide/user-state-persistence` | `ui/console.mdx#what-each-users-own-state-keeps` | Per-user favorites, pins, recents, list state and overlay width; keys and limits; list state never writes the view; Reset view. Not carried: the React hooks (SDK) |
| `guide/expressions` | `ui/pages.mdx#expression-holes-in-element-properties` | `${…}` holes in element properties, their roots, locale maps, what an unresolved hole renders. Dropped: the JS-style `${…}` `visibleWhen` / `hidden` / `disabled` examples (the spec makes those CEL predicates) and the `PredicateScopeProvider` / evaluator API (SDK) |
| `guide/print-pages` | `ui/print-pages.mdx#print-in-the-browser` | The Print button and browser print preview, the named record-page route, the key → print CSS table, blocks printing whole. Merged into the one page |
| `guide/react-pages` | `ui/react-pages.mdx`, `ui/pages.mdx#list-blocks-in-a-region` | `<box>` as the html-tier wrapper, no raw-HTML block; list-block sizing in regions and tab badges. The rest the target already says. Merged into the one page |
| `guide/agent-skills` | `ai/skills.mdx#the-skill-catalog` | The `objectui` skill ships in `@objectstack/skills`, its structure and its boundary. Dropped: the `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectui` install (the catalog installs from npm) |
| `core/app-schema` | `ui/apps.mdx#action-navigation` | How the Console runs an `action` navigation item. Dropped: `AppComponentSchema` (`menu`, `path`, `layout`, `hidden: '${…}'`), which the spec's `AppSchema` refuses |
| `core/report-schema` | `ui/reports.mdx` | Nothing new. The page documents `@object-ui/types`' `ReportComponentSchema` (inline `fields`, `filters`, `schedule`, `exportConfigs`), which the spec's dataset-bound `ReportSchema` does not accept |
| `core/enhanced-actions` | `ui/actions.mdx#collect-input-and-shape-the-ux` | Param widgets, field-backed params on the selection bar, emitted value shapes, Confirm disabled during upload, param `visible`; `successMessage` `{{ }}` holes, `outcomeMessages`, `onSuccess`. Dropped: `ajax` / `confirm` / `dialog` action types, `chain`, `condition`, `tracking`, `retry` (the `@object-ui/types` `ActionSchema`, not the spec's) |
| `core/theme-schema` | `ui/apps.mdx#branding` | `accentColor`, the `--primary` / `--accent` mapping, the single logo asset, no theme document in metadata. Not carried: `ThemeProvider` / `useTheme` / the `Theme` document (React SDK; the spec retired its theme module) |
| `layout/page-header` | `ui/pages.mdx#the-page-header`, `ui/actions.mdx#permissions-and-visibility` | The props table, `actions` as the whole id set, the record chip, the one-`<h1>` rule; relation fields bind as their id and `current_user.can` / `hasCapability` gates. Not carried: Tailwind class lists and the React `PageHeader` export. Corrected: `os.user` examples to `current_user` |

`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json` gains the two new pages, which `check:docs-audit-scope` requires of any new hand-written page.

## Why

objectui.org folds into the objectstack docs site (Tesla's option B on the fold evaluation). Metadata authors and Console users read objectstack.ai/docs, and today half of a field's or a page's behaviour lives on a site that goes away with the fold.

## Tests

Docs only: no code, no test changes. The carried claims were checked by reading `packages/spec` (Zod schemas and their descriptions) and, for routes and commands, the server and CLI sources; the corrections are named in the rows above.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs build`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 53 command families for this diff; all 53 ran locally with exit 0 (`--ran` reconciliation: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN), including `check:docs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture` and `check:skill-examples` (270 prose examples type-check).
- The first sweep found three things, fixed in this branch: the audit-scope list lacked the two new pages, a table cell used a reserved word, and the `editMode` example object declared no `sharingModel`.

## Acceptance notes

- Each of the 46 pages has a row above naming its target and what was carried, or "nothing new".
- No carried claim contradicts `packages/spec`; where an objectui page did, the claim was dropped or corrected, and the row says so.
- Serial constraint with K3 (#27142): this PR adds `console` and `studio` to `content/docs/ui/meta.json`; whichever lands second merges `main`.
